ADM_CUST_001.scenario: Verify that the Customers page opens automatically as the first screen after an admin logs in.
ADM_CUST_001.preconditions: An admin account is available (mobile 8888888888 / OTP 258369).
ADM_CUST_001.steps:
1. Open the Admin portal login page.
2. Enter the mobile number, request the OTP, and enter the code.
3. Complete login and watch where the browser lands.
ADM_CUST_001.expected: After login the browser lands on the Customers page (web address ends in /admin/customers). The row of six summary cards at the top and the registrations table below both finish loading within about 5 seconds.

ADM_CUST_002.scenario: Verify that all six summary cards appear in the correct order across the top of the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_002.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_002.steps:
1. Look at the row of summary cards across the top of the page.
2. Read each card title from left to right.
ADM_CUST_002.expected: Six cards are shown in this order: Registered, Inactive Registrations, Cancelled Registrations, KYC Pending (Booked), Confirmed (Paid + KYC), and Active Towers.

ADM_CUST_003.scenario: Verify that the Registered summary card shows a number count.
ADM_CUST_003.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_003.steps:
1. Find the card titled 'Registered' at the top of the page.
2. Read the number shown on it.
ADM_CUST_003.expected: The Registered card shows a non-zero number (for example 8,673). (This figure is the combined total of Booked Offline + Booked Online + Registered + Inactive registrations, not just those marked 'Registered'.)

ADM_CUST_006.scenario: Verify that the heading above the table states the total number of registration records.
ADM_CUST_006.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_006.steps: 1. Look at the heading directly above the registrations table.
ADM_CUST_006.expected: The heading reads 'N Registration Records' where N is a number (for example '9,684 Registration Records'). This is the true total record count, not the count of rows visible on screen.

ADM_CUST_007.scenario: Verify that the registrations table shows all ten expected columns in order.
ADM_CUST_007.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_007.steps:
1. Look at the column headers across the top of the registrations table.
2. Read them left to right.
ADM_CUST_007.expected: The columns appear in this order: Registration Details, Growth Partner, Phone, Home Loan Details, Confirmation Number, Alloted Unit, Allocation Status, Confirmation, Process Status, and Actions.

ADM_CUST_008.scenario: Verify that the newest registrations appear at the top of the table.
ADM_CUST_008.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_008.steps: 1. In the Registration Details column, read the dates from the top row downward.
ADM_CUST_008.expected: Rows are ordered with the most recently created registration at the top and older ones further down (newest first).

ADM_CUST_009.scenario: Verify that the Registration Details column shows both a registration number and a creation date.
ADM_CUST_009.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_009.steps: 1. Pick any row and look at its Registration Details cell.
ADM_CUST_009.expected: The cell shows a registration number (for example GHNG-1000008563-AT) together with the date and time it was created.

ADM_CUST_010.scenario: Verify that the Allocation Status column only ever shows one of the allowed status values.
ADM_CUST_010.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_010.steps:
1. Read the values in the Allocation Status column down the page.
2. Move through a few pages to see the different values that appear.
ADM_CUST_010.expected: Every Allocation Status value is one of: Registered, Booked Online, Booked Offline, Waitlisted, or Cancelled.

ADM_CUST_011.scenario: Verify that the Process Status column shows the customer's KYC stage.
ADM_CUST_011.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_011.steps: 1. Read the values in the Process Status column.
ADM_CUST_011.expected: Each cell shows either 'KYC Pending' or 'KYC Completed'. Pending rows may also show the helper note 'Required to complete KYC from Customer!'.

ADM_CUST_012.scenario: Verify that the Confirmation column shows 'Paid' for paid customers and is blank otherwise.
ADM_CUST_012.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_012.steps: 1. Look at the Confirmation column for several rows.
ADM_CUST_012.expected: Each cell either shows 'Paid' (payment received) or is blank / shows a dash when no payment has been made yet.

ADM_CUST_021.scenario: Verify that the pagination bar shows which records are being viewed out of the total.
ADM_CUST_021.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_021.steps:
1. Scroll to the bottom of the table.
2. Read the summary text in the pagination bar.
ADM_CUST_021.expected: The text reads 'Showing 1-10 of N items', where N is the total number of registration records.

ADM_CUST_025.scenario: Verify that each registration row offers a trash (delete) icon and a three-dot menu in the Actions column.
ADM_CUST_025.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_025.steps: 1. Look at the Actions column (far right) on any normal row.
ADM_CUST_025.expected: The Actions cell shows a trash (bin) icon and a three-dot (…) menu icon. Rows that are in a refund state instead show only a dash ('-') with no icons.

ADM_CUST_035.scenario: Verify that the downloaded registrations file contains all seventeen data columns.
ADM_CUST_035.preconditions: A RegistrationData.xlsx file has been downloaded from the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_035.steps:
1. Open the downloaded RegistrationData.xlsx file in Excel.
2. Count the columns.
ADM_CUST_035.expected: The spreadsheet has 17 columns of registration data.

ADM_CUST_038.scenario: Verify that a customer's multiple sub-registrations each appear as their own separate row.
ADM_CUST_038.preconditions: A customer who has more than one sub-registration (suffixes -A, -B, -C) exists.
ADM_CUST_038.steps:
1. Type the customer's phone number into the 'Search by Phone' box.
2. Look at the Registration Details column in the results.
ADM_CUST_038.testData: Phone: a customer known to have multiple sub-registrations (ask user)
ADM_CUST_038.expected: Each sub-registration (for example GHNG-XXXX-A, GHNG-XXXX-B, GHNG-XXXX-C) is listed as its own row. (These represent the same buyer's different unit preferences. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] specific phone number.)

ADM_CUST_105.scenario: Verify that the Cancel Registration confirmation popup shows the registration number and refund amount.
ADM_CUST_105.preconditions: The Cancel Registration popup is open, opened from a Registered or Waitlisted row.
ADM_CUST_105.steps: 1. Look at the details shown inside the Cancel Registration popup before the confirm button.
ADM_CUST_105.expected: The popup ('Confirm Refund') shows the registration number (for example GHNG-1000008563-AT), the unit (or 'Not Assigned'), and a warning that ₹999 must be refunded offline, before the red Cancel Registration button.

TC_CUST_FUNC_046.scenario: Verify that the Cancel Registration popup clearly shows the ₹999 refund amount.
TC_CUST_FUNC_046.preconditions: The Cancel Registration popup is open, opened from a Registered or Waitlisted row.
TC_CUST_FUNC_046.steps: 1. Read the refund amount shown in the popup.
TC_CUST_FUNC_046.expected: The popup shows '₹999' as the refund amount (the figure is shown in bold). (₹999 is the fixed registration confirmation amount per business rule.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_053.scenario: Verify that each milestone row shows the correct payment-status label for its progress.
TC_CUST_FUNC_053.preconditions: A booked unit's milestone schedule is open, containing milestones at different payment stages.
TC_CUST_FUNC_053.steps:
1. Find a milestone that has had no payment yet and read its status label.
2. Find a milestone that has been partly paid and read its status label.
3. Find a milestone that has been fully paid and read its status label.
4. Find a milestone whose start date is in the future and look at its status cell.
TC_CUST_FUNC_053.expected: An unpaid milestone shows a 'Pending' label with a clock icon; a partly-paid one shows 'Partial Payment' with a card icon; a fully-paid one shows 'Paid' with a check-circle icon; a future-dated milestone has an empty status cell. (A registration-fee line with a total of 0 shows a dash '-'.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_054.scenario: Verify that an 'Offline Payment' button appears on milestone rows that are due and still owe money.
TC_CUST_FUNC_054.preconditions: A booked unit's milestone schedule is open and contains a past-due milestone with an outstanding balance.
TC_CUST_FUNC_054.steps: 1. Look at the Action column for a milestone whose start date has passed and which still has money outstanding.
TC_CUST_FUNC_054.expected: An 'Offline Payment' button is shown on that milestone row. Rows with a future start date, or a registration-fee line with a total of 0, do not show the button.

TC_CUST_FUNC_061.scenario: Verify that the Unit Swap window displays all of its expected fields and controls.
TC_CUST_FUNC_061.preconditions: The three-dot menu is open on a Booked row.
TC_CUST_FUNC_061.steps:
1. Click 'Unit swap' in the menu.
2. Look over the window that opens.
TC_CUST_FUNC_061.expected: A 'Unit Swap' window opens showing read-only Registration Number, Current Unit (for example 2404-Crown) and Apartment Type with carpet area, a Tower dropdown, a Unit dropdown that stays disabled until a tower is chosen, two confirmation checkboxes, and a Submit button that is disabled to begin with.

TC_CUST_FUNC_081.scenario: Verify that the Update Parking window opens with the unit's existing parking details already filled in.
TC_CUST_FUNC_081.preconditions: A booked unit that already has parking enabled (2 parking spaces at ₹2,50,000 each).
TC_CUST_FUNC_081.steps:
1. Open the three-dot menu on that booked row and click 'Update Parking Details'.
2. Look at the values shown in the window.
TC_CUST_FUNC_081.testData: A booked unit with parking enabled, count 2, amount 250000 (ask user)
TC_CUST_FUNC_081.expected: The window opens with the parking toggle ON, Parking Count showing 2, Parking Amount showing 250000, and a Total Parking Amount preview of 500000. ([TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a booked unit pre-set with these parking values.)

TC_CUST_UI_041.scenario: Verify that the bold 'Allocation Opened' label is always shown above the registrations table.
TC_CUST_UI_041.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
TC_CUST_UI_041.steps: 1. Look at the area directly above the registrations table.
TC_CUST_UI_041.expected: A bold 'Allocation Opened' label is shown as the table title, with that exact wording. (Note: this label is fixed in place and always shows regardless of whether any allocation campaign is actually open — a known display issue, not a live status signal.)

ADM_CUST_013.scenario: Verify that typing a registered customer's phone number into the Search box filters the list to show only that customer.
ADM_CUST_013.preconditions: An admin is on the Customers page and a valid registered phone number is known.
ADM_CUST_013.steps:
1. Click the 'Search by Phone' box above the table.
2. Type a known 10-digit phone number.
3. Wait for the list to refresh.
ADM_CUST_013.testData: Phone: a known registered number (ask user)
ADM_CUST_013.expected: The table updates to show only rows whose Phone column matches the number typed. (Search works on phone number only — it does not match on customer name, registration number, or unit number. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a known phone.)

ADM_CUST_014.scenario: Verify that clearing the Search box brings back the full customer list.
ADM_CUST_014.preconditions: A phone search has been applied and the list is filtered.
ADM_CUST_014.steps:
1. Delete the text from the 'Search by Phone' box.
2. Wait for the list to reload.
ADM_CUST_014.expected: The table goes back to showing all records and the heading count returns to the original total.

ADM_CUST_015.scenario: Verify that clicking 'Filter' reveals the filtering options for the table.
ADM_CUST_015.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_015.steps: 1. Click the 'Filter' button above the table.
ADM_CUST_015.expected: The filter controls appear, offering filters for Allocation Status, Home Loan Details, Confirmation, and Process Status. (The 'Filter' button label switches to 'Reset Filters'.)

ADM_CUST_016.scenario: Verify that filtering by Allocation Status 'Registered' shows only registered customers.
ADM_CUST_016.preconditions: The filter controls are open on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_016.steps:
1. Under Allocation Status, choose 'Registered'.
2. Apply the filter (click OK).
ADM_CUST_016.expected: The table shows only rows whose Allocation Status is 'Registered'.

ADM_CUST_017.scenario: Verify that filtering by Process Status 'KYC Completed' shows only customers who finished KYC.
ADM_CUST_017.preconditions: The filter controls are open on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_017.steps:
1. Under Process Status, choose 'KYC Completed'.
2. Apply the filter (click OK).
ADM_CUST_017.expected: The table shows only rows whose Process Status is 'KYC Completed'.

ADM_CUST_018.scenario: Verify that 'Reset Filters' clears every active filter and shows all records again.
ADM_CUST_018.preconditions: At least one filter has been applied.
ADM_CUST_018.expected: All filters clear and the table reloads the full set of records.

ADM_CUST_019.scenario: Verify that applying two filters together shows only the rows that match both.
ADM_CUST_019.preconditions: The filter controls are open on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_019.steps:
1. Under Allocation Status, choose 'Booked Online'.
2. Under Confirmation, choose 'Paid'.
3. Apply the filters (click OK).
ADM_CUST_019.testData: Allocation Status: Booked Online; Confirmation: Paid
ADM_CUST_019.expected: The table shows only rows that match BOTH conditions (Booked Online and Paid).

ADM_CUST_020.scenario: Verify that clicking 'Refresh' reloads the table without leaving the page.
ADM_CUST_020.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_020.steps:
1. Click the 'Refresh' button.
2. Watch the table.
ADM_CUST_020.expected: The table reloads its data from the server (a brief loading state may flash). The page does not navigate away.

ADM_CUST_022.scenario: Verify that changing the page size to 50 shows 50 rows per page.
ADM_CUST_022.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_022.steps:
1. At the bottom of the table, click the page-size dropdown (it shows '10 / page' by default).
2. Choose '50'.
ADM_CUST_022.expected: The table reloads showing 50 rows per page and the pagination summary updates to 'Showing 1-50 of N items'.

ADM_CUST_023.scenario: Verify that the Next arrow moves the table to the following page of records.
ADM_CUST_023.preconditions: An admin is on the Customers page and there is more than one page of records.
ADM_CUST_023.steps: 1. Click the Next (right arrow) button in the pagination bar.
ADM_CUST_023.expected: The table shows the next 10 records and the summary updates to 'Showing 11-20 of N items'.

ADM_CUST_024.scenario: Verify that clicking a page number jumps directly to that page.
ADM_CUST_024.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_024.steps: 1. Click the page number '3' in the pagination bar.
ADM_CUST_024.expected: The table jumps to page 3 and shows records 21-30.

ADM_CUST_026.scenario: Verify that clicking the trash icon opens the relevant cancel flow (this older test has been split into the Cancel Unit and Cancel Registration tests below).
ADM_CUST_026.steps: 1. This older single test is no longer used. Use the separate Cancel Unit and Cancel Registration tests instead.
ADM_CUST_026.expected: Superseded — see the dedicated Cancel Unit (Booked rows) and Cancel Registration (Registered/Waitlisted rows) tests.

ADM_CUST_027.scenario: Verify that the cancel popup shows the ₹999 refund amount (superseded; now covered by the dedicated Cancel Registration tests).
ADM_CUST_027.preconditions: A Registered or Waitlisted row is available.
ADM_CUST_027.steps: 1. This older test is no longer used. Use the dedicated Cancel Registration refund test instead.
ADM_CUST_027.expected: Superseded — refund display is now verified by the dedicated Cancel Registration tests (refund amount is ₹999).

ADM_CUST_028.scenario: Verify that confirming a cancellation shows a success message (superseded; now covered by the dedicated Cancel Registration tests).
ADM_CUST_028.preconditions: A Registered or Waitlisted row is available.
ADM_CUST_028.steps: 1. This older test is no longer used. Use the dedicated Cancel Registration confirmation test instead.
ADM_CUST_028.expected: Superseded — the success message is now verified by the dedicated Cancel Registration test ('Registration refunded successfully').

ADM_CUST_030.scenario: Verify that the three-dot menu on a row opens a list of available actions.
ADM_CUST_030.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_030.steps: 1. Click the three-dot (…) menu in the Actions column of a row.
ADM_CUST_030.expected: A dropdown opens. 'Home Loan Approval' is always listed. The other items depend on the row's status: a Registered row also shows 'Assign Unit'; a Booked row also shows 'View Milestones', 'Unit swap', and 'Update Parking Details'.

ADM_CUST_031.scenario: Verify that choosing 'Home Loan Approval' opens a window with an approval toggle.
ADM_CUST_031.preconditions: The three-dot menu is open on a row.
ADM_CUST_031.expected: A 'Home Loan Approval' window opens showing the Registration Number, the Apartment Type, an Enable/Disable toggle switch, and a Submit button.

ADM_CUST_032.scenario: Verify that enabling the toggle and saving approves the home loan, and that no message is sent to the buyer.
ADM_CUST_032.preconditions: The Home Loan Approval window is open.
ADM_CUST_032.steps:
1. Switch the Enable toggle on.
2. Click Submit.
3. Check whether the buyer received any SMS, WhatsApp, or email.
ADM_CUST_032.expected: The home loan is marked approved and the window closes; the approved home-loan offer becomes available to the buyer. No SMS, WhatsApp, or email is sent to the buyer (this approval is silent by design — verify backend records updated rather than expecting a buyer message).

ADM_CUST_033.scenario: Verify that the 'Cancel Bulk Units' button opens the bulk cancellation flow.
ADM_CUST_033.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_033.steps: 1. Click the 'Cancel Bulk Units' button above the table.
ADM_CUST_033.expected: The bulk-cancellation interface opens, allowing several sub-registrations to be cancelled at once.

ADM_CUST_034.scenario: Verify that the 'Download' button exports the registrations as an Excel file.
ADM_CUST_034.preconditions: An admin is logged in and on the Customers page.
ADM_CUST_034.steps:
1. Click the 'Download' button (top-right area).
2. Wait for the download to finish.
ADM_CUST_034.expected: A file named RegistrationData.xlsx downloads automatically.

ADM_CUST_036.scenario: Verify that a download made while a filter is active includes only the filtered records.
ADM_CUST_036.preconditions: A filter is active on the table (for example Allocation Status = Cancelled).
ADM_CUST_036.steps:
1. Apply a filter.
2. Click 'Download'.
3. Open the downloaded file and count the rows.
ADM_CUST_036.expected: The downloaded file contains only the records that match the active filter. With the Cancelled filter on, the row count matches the Cancelled Registrations card figure. With no filter, the file contains all records. (The export covers every matching record across all pages, not just the current page.)

ADM_CUST_098.scenario: Verify that closing the Cancel Unit window with the X discards the action and leaves the unit booked.
ADM_CUST_098.preconditions: The Cancel Unit window is open from a Booked row.
ADM_CUST_098.steps:
1. Tick both confirmation checkboxes.
2. Click the X (close) in the top-right corner instead of Submit.
3. Find the same row again in the list.
ADM_CUST_098.expected: The window closes, nothing is cancelled, the row keeps its Booked Online/Offline status, and the unit is not released.

ADM_CUST_099.scenario: Verify that cancelling a unit on a Booked Offline row releases that unit back into inventory.
ADM_CUST_099.preconditions: A row with Allocation Status 'Booked Offline' exists; note the allotted unit number. (Destructive — requires user authorisation before submitting on UAT.)
ADM_CUST_099.steps:
1. Click the trash icon on the row, tick both confirmation checkboxes, and click Submit.
2. Open the Towers page and go to the tower that unit belongs to.
3. Find the unit on the tower grid.
ADM_CUST_099.testData: A test Booked Offline row with its unit number (ask user)
ADM_CUST_099.expected: The unit's cell on the tower grid turns white (Available) or grey (Reserved) depending on status sync, and is no longer shown as sold. ([TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable Booked Offline test record and user sign-off to submit.)

ADM_CUST_101.scenario: Verify that the Cancel Unit confirmation checkboxes always start unticked each time the window is opened.
ADM_CUST_101.steps:
1. Open the Cancel Unit window, tick both checkboxes, then close it with the X.
2. Open the Cancel Unit window again on the same row.
ADM_CUST_101.expected: Both confirmation checkboxes are unticked when the window reopens, and the Submit button is disabled.

ADM_CUST_102.scenario: Verify that closing the Cancel Registration popup with its Cancel button discards the action and issues no refund.
ADM_CUST_102.preconditions: The Cancel Registration popup is open from a Registered or Waitlisted row.
ADM_CUST_102.steps:
1. Click the 'Cancel' (close) button instead of the red 'Cancel Registration' button.
2. Find the row again.
ADM_CUST_102.expected: The popup closes, the row keeps its Registered/Waitlisted status, no refund is made, and the ₹999 is not refunded.

ADM_CUST_103.scenario: Verify that cancelling a registration on a Waitlisted row issues the ₹999 refund.
ADM_CUST_103.preconditions: A Waitlisted row that has paid ₹999 exists. (Destructive — requires user authorisation before submitting on UAT.)
ADM_CUST_103.steps:
1. Click the trash icon on the Waitlisted row.
2. Click the red 'Cancel Registration' button.
3. Open the Payment Transactions page and find the refund record for that registration.
ADM_CUST_103.testData: A test Waitlisted row with ₹999 paid (ask user)
ADM_CUST_103.expected: The row's status changes to Cancelled, a ₹999 refund record appears on the Payment Transactions page for that registration, and a 'Registration refunded successfully' message is shown. ([TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable Waitlisted test record and user sign-off to submit.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_036b.scenario: Verify that downloading while the Cancelled filter is active produces a file whose row count matches the Cancelled total.
TC_CUST_FUNC_036b.preconditions: The Allocation Status filter is set to Cancelled so only cancelled rows are listed.
TC_CUST_FUNC_036b.steps:
1. With the Cancelled filter active, click 'Download'.
2. Open the file and count the data rows.
TC_CUST_FUNC_036b.expected: The file contains only cancelled records; its row count equals the Cancelled Registrations card figure and is fewer than an unfiltered export. (Confirms the export honours active filters.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_042.scenario: Verify that the trash icon on a Booked row opens the 'Cancel Unit' window (not the 'Cancel Registration' popup).
TC_CUST_FUNC_042.preconditions: A row with Allocation Status 'Booked Online' or 'Booked Offline' is on screen.
TC_CUST_FUNC_042.steps:
1. Hover the trash icon on the Booked row and check the tooltip reads 'Cancel Unit'.
2. Click the trash icon.
TC_CUST_FUNC_042.expected: A window opens titled 'Please make sure that following actions are completed?' with two confirmation checkboxes: 'Activity - Token, Form, Booking deleted' and 'Mavis - Booking entry deleted'. No refund amount is shown.

TC_CUST_FUNC_044.scenario: Verify that submitting a Cancel Unit shows the 'Unit cancelled successfully' message.
TC_CUST_FUNC_044.preconditions: The Cancel Unit window is open on a disposable test Booked row with both checkboxes ticked. (Destructive — requires user authorisation; also needs upstream Mavis cleanup done first.)
TC_CUST_FUNC_044.steps:
1. Click Submit.
2. Watch for the confirmation message and check the row's state.
TC_CUST_FUNC_044.testData: A test Booked row safe to cancel (ask user)
TC_CUST_FUNC_044.expected: A 'Unit cancelled successfully' message appears (not 'Registration refunded successfully'). The allotted unit is released back to inventory, while the parent registration and any sibling sub-registrations stay intact. ([TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable Booked record and user sign-off.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_045.scenario: Verify that the trash icon on a Registered or Waitlisted row opens the 'Cancel Registration' popup.
TC_CUST_FUNC_045.preconditions: A row with Allocation Status 'Registered' or 'Waitlisted' (no unit allotted, only ₹999 paid) is on screen.
TC_CUST_FUNC_045.steps:
1. Hover the trash icon and check the tooltip reads 'Cancel Registration'.
2. Click the trash icon.
TC_CUST_FUNC_045.expected: A 'Confirm Refund' popup opens showing any unit details and the refund amount ₹999, with a red 'Cancel Registration' button.

TC_CUST_FUNC_047.scenario: Verify that confirming a Cancel Registration shows 'Registration refunded successfully' and sends no message to the buyer.
TC_CUST_FUNC_047.preconditions: The Cancel Registration popup is open on a disposable test Registered/Waitlisted record. (Destructive — requires user authorisation.)
TC_CUST_FUNC_047.steps:
1. Click the red 'Cancel Registration' button.
2. Check whether the buyer received any SMS, WhatsApp, or email after the refund.
TC_CUST_FUNC_047.testData: A test Registered/Waitlisted record safe to cancel (ask user)
TC_CUST_FUNC_047.expected: A 'Registration refunded successfully' message appears, the row's status becomes Cancelled, and the ₹999 is refunded to the original payment method. No SMS, WhatsApp, or email is sent to the buyer (this refund is silent by design). ([TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable record and user sign-off.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_051.scenario: Verify that choosing 'View Milestones' opens the milestone schedule for that booking.
TC_CUST_FUNC_051.preconditions: The three-dot menu is open on a Booked row.
TC_CUST_FUNC_051.steps:
1. Click 'View Milestones'.
2. Watch the page that opens.
TC_CUST_FUNC_051.expected: The Milestone Payment Schedule page opens, with a header card showing the Registration Number and Unit Number as read-only details. (The web address carries the registration number and unit id.)

TC_CUST_FUNC_055.scenario: Verify that the Offline Payment form collects all of its expected fields and requires a payment proof.
TC_CUST_FUNC_055.preconditions: The Offline Payment panel is open for a milestone that is due for payment.
TC_CUST_FUNC_055.steps:
1. Check the form shows: Registration Number (read-only), Amount, Payment Method (NEFT / Cheque / Cash / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI), Transaction ID, Transaction Date & Time, Comments (optional), and a Payment Proof upload.
2. Try to submit without attaching a payment proof.
TC_CUST_FUNC_055.expected: All the visible fields are shown. Submit is blocked until a payment proof is attached (it is required). The Transaction Date cannot be set to a future date.

TC_CUST_FUNC_056.scenario: Verify that 'Back to Customer Listing' returns from the milestone page to the customer dashboard.
TC_CUST_FUNC_056.preconditions: The Milestone Payment Schedule page is open.
